examples.hanzi: 他用铁棍把盖子撬开了。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng tiěgùn bǎ gàizi qiào kāi le.
examples.english: He pried the lid open with an iron bar.

examples.hanzi: 小偷想撬锁进屋。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎotōu xiǎng qiào suǒ jìn wū.
examples.english: The thief wanted to pick the lock and get in.

examples.hanzi: 大家都把他看作敌人。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu bǎ tā kànzuò dírén.
examples.english: Everyone regards him as an enemy.

examples.hanzi: 这支球队的实力无人能敌。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī qiúduì de shílì wú rén néng dí.
examples.english: This team's strength has no match.

examples.hanzi: 他的车子飙得太快了。
examples.pinyin: Tā de chēzi biāo de tài kuài le.
examples.english: His car was speeding too fast.

examples.hanzi: 最近天气很热，气温一路飙升。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn tiānqì hěn rè, qìwēn yílù biāoshēng.
examples.english: The weather is hot lately and temperatures keep soaring.

examples.hanzi: 外面下雨了，我们先避一避。
examples.pinyin: Wàimiàn xià yǔ le, wǒmen xiān bì yi bì.
examples.english: It is raining outside, so let's take shelter first.

examples.hanzi: 这样做可以避免很多麻烦。
examples.pinyin: Zhèyàng zuò kěyǐ bìmiǎn hěn duō máfan.
examples.english: Doing this can avoid a lot of trouble.

examples.hanzi: 你可以把没用的照片删掉。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ bǎ méi yòng de zhàopiàn shān diào.
examples.english: You can delete the useless photos.

examples.hanzi: 请不要随意删改这份文件。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng búyào suíyì shāngǎi zhè fèn wénjiàn.
examples.english: Please do not delete or edit this file at will.

examples.hanzi: 他的话得到了很多事实佐证。
examples.pinyin: Tā de huà dédào le hěn duō shìshí zuǒzhèng.
examples.english: His words have been backed up by a lot of facts.

examples.hanzi: 这道菜里放了一点佐料。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài lǐ fàng le yìdiǎn zuǒliào.
examples.english: A little seasoning was added to this dish.

examples.hanzi: 这家店昨晚被盗了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn zuówǎn bèi dào le.
examples.english: This shop was robbed last night.

examples.hanzi: 我们要防止盗版软件。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào fángzhǐ dàobǎn ruǎnjiàn.
examples.english: We must prevent pirated software.

examples.hanzi: 这里的土地肥沃，适合种菜。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de tǔdì féiwò, shìhé zhòng cài.
examples.english: The land here is fertile and good for growing vegetables.

examples.hanzi: 他们在沃土上种了麦子。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen zài wòtǔ shàng zhòng le màizi.
examples.english: They planted wheat in the rich soil.

examples.hanzi: 这个词的意义是什么？
examples.pinyin: Zhège cí de yìyì shì shénme?
examples.english: What is the meaning of this word?

examples.hanzi: 他做志愿者是出于正义感。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuò zhìyuànzhě shì chūyú zhèngyìgǎn.
examples.english: He volunteers out of a sense of justice.

examples.hanzi: 雪山崩了，很危险。
examples.pinyin: Xuěshān bēng le, hěn wēixiǎn.
examples.english: The snow mountain collapsed, and it was dangerous.

examples.hanzi: 他一听这个消息，情绪崩溃了。
examples.pinyin: Tā yì tīng zhège xiāoxi, qíngxù bēngkuì le.
examples.english: On hearing the news, his emotions broke down.

examples.hanzi: 她喜欢织围巾送给朋友。
examples.pinyin: Tā xǐhuan zhī wéijīn sòng gěi péngyou.
examples.english: She likes knitting scarves for her friends.

examples.hanzi: 他们在工厂里织布。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen zài gōngchǎng lǐ zhī bù.
examples.english: They weave cloth in the factory.

examples.hanzi: 他赤着脚在草地上跑。
examples.pinyin: Tā chì zhe jiǎo zài cǎodì shàng pǎo.
examples.english: He ran barefoot on the grass.

examples.hanzi: 赤道附近的天气很热。
examples.pinyin: Chìdào fùjìn de tiānqì hěn rè.
examples.english: The weather near the equator is very hot.

examples.hanzi: 这个月末，我们要搬家。
examples.pinyin: Zhège yuèmò, wǒmen yào bānjiā.
examples.english: At the end of this month, we are moving.

examples.hanzi: 他喜欢周末睡懒觉。
examples.pinyin: Tā xǐhuan zhōumò shuì lǎnjiào.
examples.english: He likes to sleep in on weekends.

examples.hanzi: 这个月的房租涨了一百块。
examples.pinyin: Zhège yuè de fángzū zhǎng le yìbǎi kuài.
examples.english: This month's rent went up by one hundred yuan.

examples.hanzi: 下雨以后，河水涨得很快。
examples.pinyin: Xià yǔ yǐhòu, héshuǐ zhǎng de hěn kuài.
examples.english: After the rain, the river rose quickly.

examples.hanzi: 到前面的红绿灯往右拐。
examples.pinyin: Dào qiánmiàn de hónglǜdēng wǎng yòu guǎi.
examples.english: Turn right at the traffic light ahead.

examples.hanzi: 不要相信陌生人，免得被拐骗。
examples.pinyin: Bú yào xiāngxìn mòshēngrén, miǎnde bèi guǎipiàn.
examples.english: Don't trust strangers, or you may get tricked.

examples.hanzi: 他的耳朵有点聋，说话要大声一点。
examples.pinyin: Tā de ěrduo yǒudiǎn lóng, shuōhuà yào dàshēng yìdiǎn.
examples.english: He is a bit hard of hearing, so speak up.

examples.hanzi: 这个学校有聋哑学生。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xuéxiào yǒu lóngyǎ xuésheng.
examples.english: This school has deaf and mute students.

examples.hanzi: 这家商店的商品种类很广。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā shāngdiàn de shāngpǐn zhǒnglèi hěn guǎng.
examples.english: This store has a wide range of goods.

examples.hanzi: 他在电视上看到了一个广告。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài diànshì shàng kàndào le yí ge guǎnggào.
examples.english: He saw an advertisement on TV.

examples.hanzi: 冬天我们裹着大衣出门。
examples.pinyin: Dōngtiān wǒmen guǒ zhe dàyī chūmén.
examples.english: In winter we go out wrapped in big coats.

examples.hanzi: 妈妈把饺子裹得很好看。
examples.pinyin: Māma bǎ jiǎozi guǒ de hěn hǎokàn.
examples.english: Mom wraps the dumplings so they look pretty.

examples.hanzi: 他每个月都储蓄一部分工资。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi ge yuè dōu chǔxù yí bùfen gōngzī.
examples.english: Every month he saves part of his salary.

examples.hanzi: 我的手机储存空间不够了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de shǒujī chǔcún kōngjiān bú gòu le.
examples.english: My phone is running out of storage space.

examples.hanzi: 他被蚊子咬了，脸都肿了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bèi wénzi yǎo le, liǎn dōu zhǒng le.
examples.english: He was bitten by a mosquito and his face swelled up.

examples.hanzi: 我的手指肿得很厉害。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de shǒuzhǐ zhǒng de hěn lìhai.
examples.english: My finger is badly swollen.

examples.hanzi: 这张贴膜要小心贴。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng tiēmó yào xiǎoxīn tiē.
examples.english: You need to apply this screen protector carefully.

examples.hanzi: 眼睛里有一层薄薄的膜。
examples.pinyin: Yǎnjing lǐ yǒu yì céng báobáo de mó.
examples.english: There is a thin membrane in the eye.

examples.hanzi: 他向公司提出了辞职。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiàng gōngsī tíchū le cízhí.
examples.english: He handed in his resignation to the company.

examples.hanzi: 我想向各位告辞了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng xiàng gèwèi gàocí le.
examples.english: I would like to take my leave of everyone.

examples.hanzi: 他想弘扬传统文化。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiǎng hóngyáng chuántǒng wénhuà.
examples.english: He wants to promote traditional culture.

examples.hanzi: 我们要弘扬勤劳的好传统。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào hóngyáng qínláo de hǎo chuántǒng.
examples.english: We should carry forward the good tradition of hard work.

examples.hanzi: 农场里养着一群大白鹅。
examples.pinyin: Nóngchǎng lǐ yǎng zhe yì qún dà báié.
examples.english: The farm keeps a flock of big white geese.

examples.hanzi: 鹅喜欢在池塘里游泳。
examples.pinyin: É xǐhuan zài chítáng lǐ yóuyǒng.
examples.english: Geese like to swim in the pond.

examples.hanzi: 我早上吃了一碗蓝莓。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zǎoshang chī le yì wǎn lánméi.
examples.english: This morning I ate a bowl of blueberries.

examples.hanzi: 这个蛋糕上有很多草莓。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dàngāo shàng yǒu hěn duō cǎoméi.
examples.english: There are many strawberries on this cake.

examples.hanzi: 这位医生亦是一位作家。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi yīshēng yì shì yí wèi zuòjiā.
examples.english: This doctor is also a writer.

examples.hanzi: 此事亦非他的责任。
examples.pinyin: Cǐ shì yì fēi tā de zérèn.
examples.english: This matter is also not his responsibility.

examples.hanzi: 祸从口出，说话要小心。
examples.pinyin: Huò cóng kǒu chū, shuōhuà yào xiǎoxīn.
examples.english: Trouble comes from the mouth, so be careful what you say.

examples.hanzi: 这次车祸让他受了伤。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì chēhuò ràng tā shòu le shāng.
examples.english: This car accident left him injured.

examples.hanzi: 她明年大学毕业了。
examples.pinyin: Tā míngnián dàxué bìyè le.
examples.english: She will graduate from university next year.

examples.hanzi: 会议已经结束，毕竟大家都累了。
examples.pinyin: Huìyì yǐjīng jiéshù, bìjìng dàjiā dōu lèi le.
examples.english: The meeting is over, because after all everyone was tired.

examples.hanzi: 他的努力终于成功了。
examples.pinyin: Tā de nǔlì zhōngyú chénggōng le.
examples.english: His efforts finally succeeded.

examples.hanzi: 她每天练功，身体很好。
examples.pinyin: Tā měitiān liàngōng, shēntǐ hěn hǎo.
examples.english: She practices martial arts every day and has a healthy body.

examples.hanzi: 昨晚一场暴雨袭来了。
examples.pinyin: Zuówǎn yì chǎng bàoyǔ xílái le.
examples.english: A heavy rainstorm struck last night.

examples.hanzi: 他沿袭了家里的传统。
examples.pinyin: Tā yánxí le jiālǐ de chuántǒng.
examples.english: He carried on his family's tradition.

examples.hanzi: 大家都夸这道菜很好吃。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu kuā zhè dào cài hěn hǎochī.
examples.english: Everyone praised this dish for being delicious.

examples.hanzi: 他说话总爱夸大其词。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuōhuà zǒng ài kuādà qící.
examples.english: He always likes to exaggerate when he speaks.

examples.hanzi: 这场地震造成了很多人死亡。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng dìzhèn zàochéng le hěn duō rén sǐwáng.
examples.english: This earthquake caused many deaths.

examples.hanzi: 他在那场战争中不幸身亡。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài nà chǎng zhànzhēng zhōng búxìng shēnwáng.
examples.english: He unfortunately died in that war.

examples.hanzi: 他不愿意做金钱的奴隶。
examples.pinyin: Tā bú yuànyì zuò jīnqián de núlì.
examples.english: He does not want to be a slave to money.

examples.hanzi: 她成了手机的奴隶。
examples.pinyin: Tā chéng le shǒujī de núlì.
examples.english: She has become a slave to her phone.

examples.hanzi: 他不小心把水泼在了我身上。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù xiǎoxīn bǎ shuǐ pō zài le wǒ shēnshang.
examples.english: He accidentally splashed water on me.

examples.hanzi: 新年时有人泼水祝福。
examples.pinyin: Xīnnián shí yǒu rén pōshuǐ zhùfú.
examples.english: At New Year some people splash water as a blessing.

examples.hanzi: 领导奉命去外地出差。
examples.pinyin: Lǐngdǎo fèngmìng qù wàidì chūchāi.
examples.english: The leader went on a business trip on orders.

examples.hanzi: 请接受我奉上的礼物。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng jiēshòu wǒ fèngshàng de lǐwù.
examples.english: Please accept the gift I respectfully present.

examples.hanzi: 小偷窃取了他的银行卡密码。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎotōu qièqǔ le tā de yínhángkǎ mìmǎ.
examples.english: The thief stole his bank card password.

examples.hanzi: 她站在门外窃听他们的谈话。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhàn zài mén wài qiètīng tāmen de tánhuà.
examples.english: She stood outside and eavesdropped on their conversation.

examples.hanzi: 老人拄着一根棍子走路。
examples.pinyin: Lǎorén zhǔ zhe yì gēn gùnzi zǒulù.
examples.english: The old man walks leaning on a stick.

examples.hanzi: 孩子们拿棍子在地上画画。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen ná gùnzi zài dìshàng huàhuà.
examples.english: The children draw on the ground with sticks.

examples.hanzi: 盾牌可以保护战士。
examples.pinyin: Dùnpái kěyǐ bǎohù zhànshì.
examples.english: A shield can protect a soldier.

examples.hanzi: 他们两个人之间有矛盾。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen liǎng ge rén zhījiān yǒu máodùn.
examples.english: There is conflict between the two of them.

examples.hanzi: 他是我的兄长。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì wǒ de xiōngzhǎng.
examples.english: He is my elder brother.

examples.hanzi: 我和他情同兄弟，不分彼此。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé tā qíng tóng xiōngdì, bù fēn bǐcǐ.
examples.english: He and I are like brothers and don't distinguish between us.

examples.hanzi: 这位妇女一个人带三个孩子。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi fùnǚ yí ge rén dài sān ge háizi.
examples.english: This woman raises three children alone.

examples.hanzi: 医院里有妇产科。
examples.pinyin: Yīyuàn lǐ yǒu fùchǎnkē.
examples.english: The hospital has an obstetrics and gynecology department.

examples.hanzi: 你把这个页面截个图给我。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bǎ zhège yèmiàn jié ge tú gěi wǒ.
examples.english: Take a screenshot of this page and send it to me.

examples.hanzi: 请截止到明天下午五点报名。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng jiézhǐ dào míngtiān xiàwǔ wǔ diǎn bàomíng.
examples.english: Please register by five tomorrow afternoon at the latest.
